apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 174 (1.1.174) fixes the Metal Performance HUD enablement key to Apple's documented MetalHudEnabled spelling and sets OpenNOW's CAMetalLayer as the HUD main layer. The in-stream Picture toggle enables the overlay and per-frame timing logs. The HUD shows display refresh range, presented FPS and frame intervals for client-side verification. It does not establish server-side Cloud G-Sync acceptance. Includes the Metal 4 triple-buffer activation fix and Cloud G-Sync request wiring. Unsigned IPA for KravaSigner.
